img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: A clawfoot tub with a shower conversion kit adds a riser, a showerhead and a ring for a curtain. It's a popular update in vintage bathrooms. We install the kit, connect it to the existing supply and make sure the drain and overflow seal properly. If the old tub faucet is leaking, this is a good time to replace it with one that's made for showers.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: Rebuilding an older valve is usually quick if parts are available. Replacing a valve behind original tile takes more. Clawfoot tub fixtures need specific parts. We diagnose and quote a flat price.

items.q: Can you repair a clawfoot tub faucet?
items.answer: Yes. We repair and replace clawfoot faucets, risers, shower conversions and drains.

items.q: Why does my shower turn hot when someone flushes?
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure. A new pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.q: Can you replace an old three-handle valve?
items.answer: Yes, with a single-handle valve and a trim plate that covers the old holes.

items.q: Is my shower leaking into the unit below?
items.preview: We test the valve, drain and tile.
items.answer: We test the valve, the drain and the tile to find the source.

items.q: Can a clawfoot tub drain be replaced?
items.answer: Yes. Drains and overflows for clawfoot tubs are still available.

items.q: Why does my shower take long to get hot?
items.answer: The farther the shower is from the heater, the longer hot water takes to arrive.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
